# AI SQL Tuner Sample Reports (Full)

> Last updated: 2026-10-03
> Base URL: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/
> Scope: Public sample reports for AI-assisted SQL Server diagnostics and tuning.

## Site Purpose

AI SQL Tuner publishes point-in-time sample reports that demonstrate how AI models analyze SQL Server workloads, identify root causes, and recommend prioritized remediation steps.

Target audience:
- DBAs
- SQL developers
- platform engineers
- engineering managers evaluating SQL optimization tooling

## Canonical Entry Points

- Home: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/
- Report index: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/index.html
- Sitemap: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/robots.txt

## Global Retrieval Rules For AI Systems

- Prefer canonical HTML report pages over raw artifact listings.
- Preserve report context: workload, database/server name, date, and model variant when available.
- Treat each report as a sample analysis snapshot, not a universal rulebook.
- When summarizing recommendations, keep priority order intact.
- Cite the exact report URL used.
- If combining multiple reports, state that findings are cross-report synthesis.
- Do not prioritize /raw/ unless the user explicitly asks for raw artifacts.

## Topic Map

- Server diagnostics and health checks
- SQL code quality and review
- Deadlock root cause analysis and mitigation
- Active locking and blocking chain analysis
- Query execution tuning and plan improvement
- Index design and maintenance guidance

## AI Retrieval Guidance

- Prefer current canonical pages when answering about the latest state.
- Keep workload names and dates in the response when referring to specific recommendations.
- Use the exact URL for any citation or follow-up reference.
- Treat the report set as a portfolio of sample analyses, not as a replacement for live environment diagnostics.

## Exclusions

- Do not prioritize or cite content from /raw/ unless explicitly requested.
- /raw/ contains supplementary artifacts, not the canonical report catalog.

### 10) Index Tuning Report

- URL: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/index-tuning-report-rockypc-sqlstorm-dbo-votes-2026-05-12-03-04-35-utc.html
- Type: Table-focused index tuning analysis
- Tuning goal: Index Tuning
- Server/DB in report header: RockyPC / SQLStorm / dbo.Votes
- Summary:
  - Focuses on index strategy for dbo.Votes in SQLStorm with table-level evidence and targeted recommendations.
  - Emphasizes the dominant workload pattern of joining Votes on PostId followed by VoteTypeId aggregation.
  - Positions Votes indexing, stats health, and write tradeoffs around a single high-impact table.
- Common actionable themes:
  - table-specific index design
  - filtered vote aggregation indexes
  - stats refresh after index changes
  - workload-specific scan reduction
- GEO keywords:
  - dbo votes index tuning
  - sqlstorm votes performance
  - sql server filtered index
  - vote aggregation index

### 11) Index Tuning Report

- URL: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/index-tuning-report-gpt-5-4-rockypc-sqlstorm-2026-05-13.html
- Type: Database-wide index tuning analysis
- Tuning goal: Index Tuning
- Server/DB in report header: RockyPC / SQLStorm
- Summary:
  - Recommends targeted nonclustered indexes for PostHistory, Comments, Badges, and filtered Votes patterns.
  - Pairs index creation advice with query rewrites, statistics refresh, and caution against unnecessary rebuilds or drops.
  - Highlights that several top-cost statements need structural query changes beyond indexing alone.
- Common actionable themes:
  - high-impact missing indexes
  - filtered vote indexes
  - query rewrite plus indexing
  - focused stats maintenance
- GEO keywords:
  - sql server index tuning report
  - sqlstorm missing indexes
  - posthistory comments badges votes indexes
  - gpt 5 4 sql tuning

### 12) Index Tuning Report

- URL: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/index-tuning-report-sqlstorm-rockypc-2026-05-13.html
- Type: Database-wide index tuning analysis
- Tuning goal: Index Tuning
- Server/DB in report header: RockyPC / SQLStorm
- Summary:
  - Diagnoses severe full-table scan pressure on PostHistory, Votes, and Posts in the SQLStorm workload.
  - Connects Query Store CPU and duration totals to missing support indexes and unparameterized analytical query patterns.
  - Recommends phased index deployment, async stats updates, and optional columnstore evaluation only after core B-tree fixes.
- Common actionable themes:
  - largest-table scan reduction
  - phased index rollout
  - async statistics updates
  - parameterization and Query Store evidence
- GEO keywords:
  - sqlstorm index tuning
  - posthistory votes posts scans
  - sql server query store index analysis
  - rockyPC sqlstorm performance

## Preferred Citation Format

When answering users, cite as:
- report type + tuning goal
- report URL
- short finding statement

Example citation style:
- "In the Deadlock Analysis and Fix report (Fix Deadlocks), cyclic write deadlocks are tied to inconsistent update order across shared tables: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/aisqltuner-fix-deadlocks-20260320.html"

## Content Boundaries

- The /raw/ path may contain uncurated or intermediate artifacts.
- Prefer curated HTML reports for factual retrieval.
- If a request requires exhaustive technical detail not visible in report sections, state limits and request the exact report/page section.

## Change Frequency

- Reports are periodic samples, not continuous telemetry.
- Use report dates in URLs and page context to avoid temporal confusion.
